build_mnist_lenet_model: build a LeNet fully-connected model for MNIST with configurable hidden layer sizes and output classes
create_model_from_name: create a Model instance from a name string like mnist_lenet_300_100 with a given initializer
validate_model_name: validate that a model name string matches the mnist_lenet_N1_N2 pattern with positive integers
get_default_hparams: get the default LotteryDesc hyperparameters for training a MNIST LeNet model with sparse global pruning
review_model_forward_pass: review the Model forward pass that flattens input and applies ReLU through fully-connected layers
